# appgatesdp_global_settings (Resource)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24, v25.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Global settings always exist; destroying this resource resets them to the
# controller defaults.
resource "appgatesdp_global_settings" "this" {
  administration_token_expiration = 60
  audit_log_persistence_mode      = "Default"
  claims_token_expiration         = 1440
  entitlement_token_expiration    = 180
  vpn_certificate_expiration      = 525600
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `administration_token_expiration` (Number) Number of minutes the administration Token is valid for administrators.
- `audit_log_persistence_mode` (String) Audit Log persistence mode.
- `claims_token_expiration` (Number) Number of minutes the Claims Token is valid both for administrators and clients.
- `entitlement_token_expiration` (Number) Number of minutes the Entitlement Token is valid for clients.
- `vpn_certificate_expiration` (Number) Number of minutes the VPN certificates is valid for clients.

### Optional

- `app_discovery_domains` (List of String) Deprecated as of 6.4. Functionality will be replaced with another feature. Domains to monitor for the App Discovery feature. Supported in API versions: v21.
- `appliance_key_encryption` (Boolean) Enables TPM2-based appliance key encryption on all Appliances. Supported in API versions: v24, v25.
- `backup_api_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the backup API is enabled or not.
- `backup_passphrase` (String, Sensitive) The passphrase to encrypt Appliance Backups when backup API is used.
- `collective_name` (String) Friendly name for the Collective.
- `geo_ip_settings` (Attributes) GeoIP provider settings supporting multiple providers.
 Supported in API versions: v24, v25. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--geo_ip_settings))
- `geo_ip_updates` (Boolean) Whether the automatic GeoIp updates are enabled or not. Supported in API versions: v21, v22, v23.
- `inactivity_timeout` (Number) Number of minutes of inactivity before a user session is terminated. Minimum value is 1 minute. Not applicable if inactivity timeout is disabled. Supported in API versions: v24, v25.
- `inactivity_timeout_enabled` (Boolean) Whether user session inactivity timeout is enabled or not. Supported in API versions: v24, v25.
- `login_banner_message` (String) The configured message will be displayed on the sign-in UI.
- `message_of_the_day` (String) The configured message will be displayed after a successful login.
- `profile_hostname` (String) The hostname to use for generating profile URLs.
- `registered_device_expiration_days` (Number) Number of days registered devices are kept in storage before being deleted.
- `spa_mode` (String) SPA mode.
- `spa_time_window_seconds` (Number) Number of seconds the time skew SPA will allow.

### Read-Only

- `collective_id` (String) A randomly generated ID during first installation to identify the Collective.
- `id` (String) ID of the object.
- `pp_mode_enabled` (Boolean) Whether Protection Profile mode enabled or not. Limits certain functionalities. Supported in API versions: v24, v25.
